meta.title: Wave Insight waveforms
meta.description: Gives the AI waveform tools for VCD, FST and GHW dumps and shows a live waveform panel in the right sidebar as signals and the time range change. Start with load_waveform(path), then use find_signals, add_signals, set_time_range, set_cursors, get_changes and list_waveform. Calling a tool opens the Wave Insight tab; the panel follows each later tool call. Helpers for Windows x64, Linux x64 and macOS ARM64 are bundled; no external binary install is needed.
